docs.title: About me
docs.text: I am deeply interested in using mathematical models to solve real-world problems. My interest also extends to efficiency with respect to algorithms and High-Performance Computing, which was the focus of my master courses. I have a solid education in solving data-related problems using machine learning, with a particular specialization in applying machine learning to graph-structured data.
